provenance: Declared illustrative stress settings; not elicited or empirically calibrated violation parameters.
target: At least one applicable policy violation, including a mistake, by the recorded discount actor in the recorded employee-location-week population.
baseline_assumption: Unlabeled location activity fitted on earlier complete weeks is used as a proxy for the no-violation observation distribution. Contamination, role, channel and promotion differences remain possible.
grid_interpretation: Unweighted sensitivity envelope. No scenario posterior weights; min/max/variance are not a credible interval or posterior parameter variance.
observation: One discount-activity count block only. Tips, amount, normalized ratios and candidate policy passes are not multiplied as independent evidence.
